brief: Why matcha — the green tea that's more than a trend. Lifestyle brand carousel.

slots.headline: More Than a Trend?
slots.subtitle: The daily ritual that goes way beyond your average cup.

slots.title: Centuries in the Making
slots.body: Monks in Japan have used matcha since the 12th century. It was never about trends—just focus and calm. That legacy lives in every bowl today.

slots.title: Nutrients, Not Just Caffeine
slots.body: You drink the whole leaf, so nothing is wasted. That means more antioxidants, more chlorophyll, and a gentler lift than coffee.

slots.title: Calm Energy, Zero Crash
slots.body: L-theanine meets caffeine for a slow, steady buzz. No jitters. No slump. Just hours of clear-headed focus without the aftermath.

slots.title: A Ritual, Not a Routine
slots.body: Whisking matcha slows you down for thirty seconds. It turns a habit into a moment. That mindfulness shapes the whole day.

slots.title: Beyond the Latte Bowl
slots.body: Smoothies, oats, face masks—matcha plays well everywhere. One vibrant green powder, endless ways to elevate your daily rituals.

slots.title: Clean, Green, and Simple
slots.body: One ingredient. No waste. Shade-grown leaves ground to a fine powder. It is as close to the earth as a drink gets.

slots.headline: Upgrade Your Morning Ritual
slots.body: Swap the jitters for calm focus. Your first bowl is waiting.
